label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into HTML output via ESAPI.encodeForHTML(), which does not sanitize all characters (specifically angle brackets '<' and '>') required for XSS prevention. The encoded output remains within the HTML context where these unencoded characters trigger script execution.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameter.
Data manipulation showing user input added to list and selected.
Unsanitized user input written to HTML response causing XSS.
